update_task_config: update task generation configuration including models, prompt templates, and feature toggles for title, tags, follow-ups, and query generation
generate_title: generate an AI-powered title for a chat conversation from a list of messages using a configured language model
generate_follow_ups: generate suggested follow-up questions or prompts for a chat conversation based on the message history
generate_queries: generate search or retrieval queries from conversation context to improve document retrieval or web search
generate_moa_response: generate a merged output response from multiple model responses using a mixture-of-agents approach
